description: Produce narrated lesson videos and their cover art from a written script, in two formats. Vertical shorts (1080x1920, Douyin/Reels ready) keep the phone app buttons' safe areas empty; landscape episodes (1920x1080, fifteen minutes) offer eleven scene layouts, among them a one-dimensional array with two pointers and reading chips, a DP table filled cell by cell, a call stack, a decision tree with pruning, a graph traversed node by node and set merging. Both run on the same idea: an HTML deck driven purely by time, edge-tts voice-over with word-level timing, Playwright frame capture and an ffmpeg mux, with a pre-render self-check for overflow, clipped code and orphan title lines, plus a 16:9 or 9:16 cover and publishing copy with at most five tags.
description_zh: 把写好的讲稿做成教学视频与配套封面，两种版式各管一段：竖屏短视频（1080×1920，抖音可直传）按手机 App 按钮留出安全区；横屏长视频（1920×1080，一集十五分钟）提供十一种幕型，含一维数组双指针与读数芯片、逐格填的二维 DP 表、调用栈、可剪枝的决策树、逐节点走的图和集合合并。两者共用同一套做法：HTML 课件按时间轴定格、edge-tts 逐词对齐配音、Playwright 逐帧截图、ffmpeg 合成，渲染前先自检越界／代码被裁／标题孤字，并给出 16:9 或 9:16 的封面与标签不超过五个的发布文案。
short_description: Narrated lesson videos from a script: 1080x1920 shorts and 1920x1080 episodes, HTML deck + edge-tts + ffmpeg.
short_description_zh: 讲稿一键成教学视频：竖屏短视频（1080×1920）与横屏长视频（1920×1080），HTML 课件 + edge-tts + ffmpeg，含封面与发布文案。
